purpose: Present consumer-supplied sources and excerpts in a readable ordered list without owning retrieval, ranking, or trust policy.
useWhen: a response or review needs adjacent source references
source labels and excerpts must remain scannable
avoidWhen: a single ordinary hyperlink is enough
the UI would imply source trust or retrieval authority
accessibility: Uses an ordered list with readable source labels and excerpts.
Does not use the citation number, color, or link presence as the only source meaning.
responsive: Wraps long source labels and excerpts inside the content rail.
Retains ordered source relationships at compact widths.
motion: Has no required motion; link feedback uses shared transitions.
Respects reduced motion through canonical link treatment.
